name: Uru
source:
Uru is a young boy who appears during the events of Tooya's route as Naala's servant. He is extremely polite and well-mannered, as well as a perfectionist who aims to fulfill his orders as best he can. His cute, feminine appearances could make one mistake him for a young girl.
